_note_quoting: argsTemplate / fullscreenArgs / windowedArgs are cut into arguments on spaces, shell-style: put double quotes around an argument that must CONTAIN a space. An argsTemplate of  -rompath "C:/My ROMs" {rom}  is two arguments before the ROM, not three.
_note_placeholders: {rom} and {fs} are substituted AFTER that cut, so a ROM path containing spaces never needs quoting.
